name: Pokémon: Hardcore Nuzlocke
summary:
A custom ROM hack built on the Pokémon FireRed and LeafGreen decompilation engine that hardcodes traditional Hardcore Nuzlocke rules directly into the gameplay.

The hack enforces strict permadeath (fainted Pokémon are permanently deleted, and whiting out wipes the save file), locks battles to "Set" mode, disables bag items during trainer battles, and imposes hard level caps before major boss fights. Alongside the built-in challenge rules, the Kanto campaign features overhauled encounters, Team Magma appearances, and revamped Gym Leader and Elite Four rosters incorporating Hoenn bosses.
